title: pilosella aurantiaca subsp. decolorans
intro: Pilosella aurantiaca subsp. decolorans, commonly known as a subspecies of the dandelion-like flowering plant, is a type of plant used in herbal medicine. This plant is said to possess various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella aurantiaca subsp. decolorans are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
